newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed in selective trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed in selective trading.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are seen mixed on Tuesday as investors target leather and pharmaceutical scrips which have fallen over the past few sessions, said brokers.

"The market may have a mixed trend after a series of corrections over the past several sessions. I see many of the shares that fell to their lowest gaining some ground today," said broker Shakil Rizvi. Scrips in the leather and pharmaceutical sectors may rise marginally, said another broker.
The DSE benchmark index closed 40.04 points or 2.71 percent down at 1,434.20 on a turnover of 87.08 million taka on Monday.
